result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my recommendation would be **Xero** for most businesses. It's user-friendly, handles Australian GST and BAS requirements, connects to bank accounts and works well with accountants and bookkeepers.

However, the best option depends on whether you're a sole trader, have employees, sell products or provide services.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Easy to use and learn.
- Bank feeds and automatic reconciliation.
- GST, BAS and payroll options.
- Excellent accountant integration.

Best for: Most small businesses.

Australian plans start around A\$37/month. [stackpick.com.au](https://stackpick.com.au/best-accounting-software-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-accounting-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

- Strong payroll functionality.
- GST and BAS reporting.
- Good inventory and job management options.

Best for: Businesses with employees, stock or more complex operations.

Business plans from around A\$35/month. [stackpick.com.au](https://stackpick.com.au/best-accounting-software-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-accounting-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Plenty of integrations.

Best for: Startups and straightforward businesses.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon One**

- Affordable accounting solution.
- GST and BAS preparation.
- Optional payroll functionality.

Best for: Smaller businesses wanting to keep costs down.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good invoicing and automation.
- Useful customer management.
- Free entry-level option for eligible businesses.

Best for: Sole traders and very small businesses.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

## Which one would I choose?

| Your business situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Sole trader | Xero or Reckon |
| Small business with employees | Xero or MYOB |
| Retail or product sales | MYOB |
| Trades or contracting | Xero |
| Consulting or professional services | Xero |
| Tight budget | Reckon One or Zoho Books |
